title: Regeneration of Acutely Injured Nerves With Temporary Electrical Stimulation
official: Regeneration of Acutely Injured Nerves With Temporary Electrical Stimulation
summary: A novel temporary peripheral nerve stimulation system that delivers a single dose of electrical stimulation therapy for 1 hour will be evaluated for safety and effectiveness.

interventions.name: Sham Temporary Peripheral Nerve Stimulation System

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Peripheral nerve injury

Exclusion criteria:

* Peripheral neuropathy
* Patients with any active implanted device

sites.f: Louisiana State University Health Sciences Center
